name: New 52-Week Highs: What Happens Next?
description: Analyzes forward 1-month (21 trading day) returns after equities make new 52-week highs. Detects new highs as close >= lagged 252-day rolling max, filtered to first-day breakouts only (avoids counting consecutive high days). Shows distribution of forward returns, key statistics (N, median, hit rate, best/worst), and navigable event markers at each breakout.
source:
# New 52-Week Highs: Forward 1-Month Return Analysis
# Detects first day at a new 52-week high, measures 21-day forward returns
# Lagged rolling max avoids look-ahead bias (S35)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# --- 52-Week High Detection ---
# Rolling 252-day max, lagged 1 bar to avoid look-ahead
rolling_high = max(period=252)(close)
prior_high = rolling_high >> 1

# New 52-week high: close meets or exceeds yesterday's 252d max
is_at_high = close >= prior_high

# First-day breakout only: was NOT at high yesterday, IS at high today
# This avoids counting consecutive days at highs as separate events
was_at_high_yesterday = is_at_high >> 1
is_new_high = is_at_high and not was_at_high_yesterday

# --- Forward Returns ---
# 21 trading day (~1 month) forward return on price
fwd_21d = forward_returns(period=21)(close)

# Isolate forward returns only on new-high days
fwd_at_high = where(is_new_high, fwd_21d)

# Win rate: dense 0/1 series for correct Mean aggregation (S29)
win_flag = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_at_high) and fwd_at_high > 0) else 0.0

# Count events using cumulative sum on a 1.0-when-event series
event_tick = 1.0 if is_valid(fwd_at_high) else 0.0
event_count = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(event_tick)

# --- Output 1: Distribution of Forward Returns ---
histogram(
    title='Do New 52-Week Highs Lead to More Gains?',
    category='52-Week High Analysis',
    bins=30,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_label='Forward 21-Day Return',
    x_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(fwd_at_high)

# --- Output 2: Summary Statistics ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Forward 21-Day Return After New 52-Week High',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=2,
        row_headers=['Events', 'Central Tendency', 'Tails'],
        col_headers=['Count / Hit Rate', 'Value'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Total new 52-week high events with valid forward returns'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='Hit rate: % of events with positive 21d forward return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Median forward 21-day return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Mean forward 21-day return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Best forward 21-day return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Worst forward 21-day return')
        ]
    ),
    category='52-Week High Analysis',
    order=2
)(event_count, win_flag, fwd_at_high, fwd_at_high, fwd_at_high, fwd_at_high)

# --- Output 3: Event Markers ---
price_at_high = where(is_new_high, close)
fwd_ret_at_high = where(is_new_high, fwd_21d)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='New 52-Week High',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Fwd 21d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(price_at_high, fwd_ret_at_high, is_new_high)
